text:
emma: Quick sync 1: were planning a midweek newsletter (codename: lighthouse-stitch) to drive downloads of the new benchmark and RSVP for the 4/18 demo. Want to test 3 subject angles and 4 audience slices. Who can own segments + timing?

ryan: Ill do segments. Proposed slices: 1) Core eng users (weekly activity), 2) New signups (<45d), 3) Enterprise leads (sales tag present), 4) Cold cohort (90+ days no open). Different primary CTA per slice.

priya: Subject ideas: A) "Benchmark: cut inference cost without sacrificing latency" B) "Lighthouse results: winners & tradeoffs" C) "Live demo 4/18 1: see benchmark highlights" Preheaders: "Top models and cost per token" vs "Reserve your seat + download"

oliver: For tracking use `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lighthouse_stitch_apr&utm_content={segment}` and header `X-Experiment: lighthouse_subject_test` so infra can tag.

emma: Send cadence proposal: US send Tue 10am PT, EU Tue 10am GMT, APAC Wed 10am SGT. For the cold cohort delay 24h and swap to subject C if no open after 48h.

ryan: Will paste SQL snippets into the campaign doc by EOD. Suppression: exclude unsubscribes + do-not-email + research-exempt.

priya: Creative: hero = simplified heatmap + pull quote. CTAs: "Download Lighthouse report" (gated) and "Register: 4/18 demo". For new signups make demo CTA primary. Also will prepare desktop/mobile crops.

deliverability-bot: Flag: subject A contains "cut inference cost" which may raise spam score for some ESPs. Suggest swap to "reduce inference costs". Also avoid multiple exclamation marks in body.

emma: Good catch. Change wording to "reduce inference costs". Action items: ryan = segment SQL (due EOD), oliver = UTMs & headers + send setup (due tonight), priya = creative + subject variants (due EOD), emma = send checklist & QA thread.

oliver: Ill run a 1k seed dry run to staging once creative + templates are in. Tag me for the seed list.

emma: Thanks team 1: if anyone spots deliverability or privacy flags, call them out here. Well aim to send next Tuesday unless QA finds regressions.
